question: Which phylum of the Kingdom Animalia exhibits an organ-system level of organisation and has a mantle or mass of soft flesh that envelops the soft body and surrounds the internal organs?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Phylum Mollusca.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Molluscans **are the most** diverse animals** and form an important part of the ecosystem in world.
 
• Example: Some of the examples of Phylum Mollusca are **snails, octopuses, squids, oysters, clams,** etc.
 
• Many organisms belonging to this phylum have a **calciferous shell**. The bodies are generally **soft** and are covered by a hard exoskeleton.
 
• They are found** **in** terrestrial regions **as well as in the **depths of the seas**.
 
• Thus, these organisms are said to have an **organ system-level organization**.
 
• The organ system level of organization is when **two or more tissues** work together to** perform** a specific** function** also these organisms have a** **mantle or** mass of soft flesh** that** envelops **their **soft body **and surrounds their** internal organs.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: *Phylum Mollusca*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
 

 __**Phylum**__
 __**Description**__
 
 

 **Phylum Ctenophora**
 
 
 
• Ctenophora are also referred to as **sea walnuts** or comb jellies.
 
• The existence of **comb plates** containing **cilia** that are employed for **propulsion** is the phylum's defining characteristic.
 
 
 
 

 **Phylum Porifera**
 
 
 
• As a sister group to the **diploblastic**, the species of the phylum Porifera, or **sponges**, constitute a basic animal lineage.
 
• They are multicellular organisms with **numerous channels **and holes that enable water to pass through them.
 
 
 
 

 **Phylum Coelenterata**
 
 
 
• The Coelenterates are primarily **marine** and **aquatic** creatures.
 
• The body is **tissue-level** organized and axially **symmetrical.**
 
• Their sensitive **tentacles** encircle their jaws, which aid in capturing their prey.
